name: Fulrik the Animator
bio: Whenever there's a mining accident, you can count on Fulrik to be the first one on the scene. A master medic, he can get his fellow Dwarves back up and at 'em in the blink of an eye, all with the help of his magical Gem of Animation. When miners see the Gem's flashing blue lights, they know help is at hand.

effects.label: Shield
